content: Patients diagnosed with pancreatic diabetes may require advanced therapeutic interventions if their blood glucose targets are not achieved through standard management strategies. In many cases, insulin therapy becomes a necessary component of treatment to maintain glycemic control. Routine screening for pancreatic exocrine insufficiency is strongly recommended in these individuals. This involves diagnostic evaluations such as fecal elastase testing to assess pancreatic enzyme function and imaging studies to identify structural abnormalities of the pancreas.
